title: 第11章 初入炼皮武夫之境第12章 武道无穷吾身无拘
content_zh:
;;
数天过去，又到了白马帮收取香油钱的日子。
豹爷带着手下，耀武扬威的出现在永宁街上，大部分街坊，都忍气吞声地交了钱。
林青也不例外，在客气递过香油钱后，恭维几句，便送走了陈豹。
轮到老樊家时，老樊总算凑齐那三百文。
“豹爷，这个月的香油钱，已经凑齐，您看下。”老樊陪着笑脸。
“嗯。”陈豹悠悠点头，收起三百文钱。
随即便是一个耳光甩了过去。
“啪！”
他直接将老樊打得眼冒金星，扑倒在地。
“豹爷，您这……”
老樊捂着脸，敢怒不敢言，嘴角还流着血。
“这个月的是交了，上个月呢？”
“连本带利，一共六百文。”
陈豹语气冷漠道。
林青心内凛然，从陈豹的口中，他听出一丝别样的意味。
莫非老樊家，是得罪了陈豹？
这时，其他围观街坊，也只敢小声开口议论。
“哎呀，老樊儿子太不懂事了。”
“那是，若不是樊奎之前得罪豹爷儿子，老樊家又怎会被处处针对。”

“那樊奎也太老实了，虽然救了一个姑娘清白，但自己全家却……唉！”
“嘘，还是小声点吧，豹爷儿子还在牢里蹲着呢。”
……
老樊听了豹爷的话语之后，心内一沉。
他当即咬牙：“豹爷说吧，要怎么样，你才可以放过我们？”
陈豹倒是冷笑起来，目光看向他身后的宅子。
“放过你们，可以，你这宅子倒是不错。”
“借给兄弟们住几天如何？”
“不可能，你做梦！”
一个木盆直接从屋内飞了出来。
陈豹脸色难看，当即侧身躲开。
就见老樊的婆娘和樊奎，已经提着棍棒冲了出来。
“老子跟你们拼了。”
樊奎大吼一声。
一棒子就要朝着陈豹的头颅砸去。
“入你娘的！”
砰！
豹爷只是一脚直蹬，直接就将樊奎踢出几米远，痛得樊奎满地打滚。
林青看得内心一凛。
光看那一脚的爆发力，这陈豹绝对是个开筋武夫，难怪平日敢明目张胆的欺行霸市。

“兄弟们，把他们往死里打！”
陈豹怒极反笑，手下帮众一拥而上。
对着老樊一家三口，便是一顿拳打脚踢。
哭喊声、求饶声、怒骂声响成一片。
content_en:
;;
A few days passed, and it was the day when the White Horse Gang collected the money for the sesame oil.
Mr. Bao and his men appeared on Yongning Street in a show of force, and most of the neighbors paid the money in silence.
Lin Qing was no exception. After politely handing over the sesame oil money and a few compliments, he sent Chen Bao away.
When it was Lao Fan's turn, Lao Fan finally collected the three hundred coins.
"Master Bao, this month's sesame oil money has been collected. Please take a look." Lao Fan accompanied him with a smile.
"Yes." Chen Bao nodded leisurely and put away the three hundred coins.
Then it was a slap in the face.
"Crack!"
He directly beat Lao Fan until stars appeared in his eyes and threw him to the ground.
"Master Bao, you..."
Lao Fan covered his face, he dared not speak in anger, and blood was still flowing from the corner of his mouth.
"I paid this month's payment, but what about last month?"
"Including principal and interest, a total of six hundred coins."
Chen Bao said in a cold tone.
Lin Qing felt awe in his heart, and he heard a different meaning from Chen Bao's mouth.
Could it be that the old Fan family offended Chen Bao?
At this time, other onlookers only dared to talk in low voices.
"Oh, Lao Fan's son is so ignorant."
"That is, if Fan Kui hadn't offended Mr. Bao's son before, how could the old Fan family be targeted everywhere."
"That Fan Kui is too honest. Although he saved a girl's innocence, his whole family... alas!"
"Shh, keep your voice down, Mr. Bao's son is still squatting in prison."
…
After hearing what Master Bao said, Lao Fan's heart sank.
He immediately gritted his teeth and said, "Master Bao, tell me, what should we do before you can let us go?"
Chen Bao sneered and looked at the house behind him.
"I'll let you go, that's fine. Your house is quite nice."
"How about lending it to the brothers for a few days?"
"No way, you're dreaming!"
A wooden basin flew directly out of the house.
Chen Bao's face turned ugly and he immediately turned sideways to avoid it.
I saw Lao Fan's mother-in-law and Fan Kui rushing out with sticks in hand.
"I will fight with you."
Fan Kui yelled.
The stick was about to hit Chen Bao's head.
"Fuck you motherfucker!"
Bang!
Mr. Bao just kicked and kicked Fan Kui several meters away, causing Fan Kui to roll on the ground in pain.
Lin Qing was shocked inwardly.
Just looking at the explosive power of that kick, Chen Bao is definitely a martial artist. No wonder he dares to blatantly bully the market.
"Brothers, beat them to death!"
Chen Bao laughed in anger, and his men rushed forward.
The three members of Lao Fan's family were beaten and kicked.
There were cries, begging for mercy, and angry curses.
